solutionSearchEvidence: Existing .gitattributes already pins LF for HTML, XML, Lua, JSON, Markdown and YAML but leaves JS/MJS at text=auto.

Current Windows raw bytes for browser/partner-conversation-core.mjs hash to 34ee260f... while the Git blob is 4c389c95..., causing exact-byte public-package tests to fail before recorder-specific checks.
The same mismatch reproduces for existing deck-save-recovery-core.mjs, proving the defect is not caused by the new recorder.
Adding explicit LF checkout policy reuses the existing repository hygiene mechanism and does not change gameplay or source semantics.
